name: Yokoshima
source:
Prototype version of [url=/v6851]Hako no Naka no Etsuraku[/url] before [url=/p1043]HYPERSPACE[/url] opened their [url=/p1077]GAIA[/url] sister brand.

Main character is a taxi driver. There are a lot of trouble clients at night, so he ends up being the only driver after dark. Somehow passenger women find his body smell irresistible and always invite him for some fun time together.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
